title: meta-ads-mcp X-Pipeboard-Token header auth bypass reuses the operator Meta token (CVE-2026-54547)
summary: meta-ads-mcp (PyPI) before 1.0.115: AuthInjectionMiddleware rejects HTTP MCP requests only when both auth_token and pipeboard_token are absent, and extract_token_from_headers() does not recognize the X-Pipeboard-Token header — an attacker sending that header with any value passes the auth gate and the server executes Meta Ads API calls with the operator's own Meta token. Fixed in 1.0.115.
